title: Group Fitness Class Passes: refund window, refund percentage and proration basis by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. For each class-credit pack tier, it states the number of days after purchase within which a refund of unused credits may be requested, the percentage of the unused-credit value refunded, and the basis used to prorate that unused-credit value.

## Basis by tier
Each tier fixes the number of days after the pack's purchase date within which a refund request qualifies, the percentage of the calculated unused-credit value that is refunded, and which of two bases values the unused credit: a per-credit basis (crediting the remaining, unused fraction of the credits included) or a percentage-elapsed basis (crediting the remaining fraction of the tier's expiration window).

| Tier | Refund window (days) | Refund percentage | Proration basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5-Class Pack | 5 | 80% | Credits used |
| 10-Class Pack | 7 | 80% | Credits used |
| 20-Class Pack | 10 | 85% | Credits used |
| Unlimited Monthly Classes | 3 | 50% | Percentage elapsed |
| Specialty Studio Pack | 10 | 85% | Credits used |
| Founding Class Pass | 10 | 85% | Credits used |

## Points of judgement
- Only the Unlimited Monthly Classes tier prorates on a percentage-elapsed basis; every other tier prorates on a credits-used basis, consistent with the Unlimited tier having no fixed credit count to measure against.
- The Unlimited Monthly Classes tier also has both the shortest refund window (3 days) and the lowest refund percentage (50%) of any tier.
